summary: An agentic CRM that assigns, answers, tells and chases on its own, with one AI for every customer and one for the owner, and speaks to the team only when a person is needed.

figures.label: message moments on the way to disbursed

open.pill: PaisaExpress · Agentic CRM for lending, Hyderabad
open.lede: PaisaExpress arranges home, personal and business loans, loans against property and credit cards in Hyderabad. Cosmiron built the agentic CRM it runs on, with two AIs living inside its WhatsApp.

ais.name: AI for the customer
ais.say: Answers every customer from their own file.

ais.name: AI for the owner
ais.say: Answers the owner about the whole operation.

who.say: PaisaExpress is a loan distributor in Hyderabad. Every enquiry has to be owned, documented, sent to a lender and followed until it disburses, however it arrived.
join: From here the system has it.

customer.sub: The customer, from their own file.
customer.say: A customer messages the number, or opens the chat on the website, and AI answers. On WhatsApp it reads that customer's own application and documents before it says a word.
knows: Knows their stage, and the one that comes next
Knows which documents are in, and which are missing
Learns a new service page in ten minutes, with no deploy
Never invents a rate, a fee or an approval

handover.title: And it hands over when
when: the customer asks for a person

exchange.text: Where is my home loan file?

exchange.src: Read from their application · stage Sanction · next Legal / Technical
exchange.text: It moved to Sanction this morning. Legal and technical checks come next.
Do you need anything from me?

exchange.src: Read from their documents · slips verified · property papers missing
exchange.text: Your salary slips are verified. The property papers are still missing.

handed.cap: Handed over. The AI goes quiet.
handed.text: Hello, I am your agent. I have your file open.

owner.sub: The owner, about the whole operation.
owner.say: The owner messages the same number, and the system knows who is asking. It answers from the live pipeline, not from a report someone prepared.
notes: At 09:00 the morning digest lands in the same chat. Reply to it and the conversation carries on.
The same brain sits on every back-office screen, where an answer opens the case itself.
owner.cap: to the owner, on WhatsApp · illustrative, invented figures

exchange.text: Seven files are past 72 hours. The oldest is a home loan at Sanction, nine days, with Agent 02.
Nine. The oldest came in yesterday evening.

pipeline.title: The live pipeline, as the AI reads it

assigns.say: Every lead gets an owner the second it lands, round robin across the agents who can actually log in.
assigns.ways: Every way in rotates the same: the website, each row of a bulk import, a lead made from a WhatsApp thread.
assigns.center: one lead, one owner, in turn
none: Nobody free? It stays unowned, on purpose.
And becomes the first line of tomorrow's nudge.

tells.say: Six moments on the way to disbursed, and the customer hears about each one. A stage sends its own name, so a stage renamed this afternoon still messages correctly tonight.
tells.note: No one writes the update. And a message that fails never holds a file back.

stops.v: Upload from this link. No login needed.
Renamed this afternoon. Tonight: your file has moved to Credit Check.

chases.say: The day arrives already read. Written fresh each morning, under sixty-five words, skipping what is fine and ending on the one thing to act on.
digest: Morning. Fourteen fresh leads came in overnight and six new logins, a decent start.
Forty-eight files are in progress, but seven have sat untouched past seventy-two hours.
First thing: the nine unassigned leads need an agent's name on them
again: The sweep pings the owning agent once per stall. A case note resets the clock.

teaser.say: AI Receptionist and AI Calling, built on CosmiVoice, Cosmiron's own voice product.

voice.name: CosmiVoice
voice.lede: The system that already answers on WhatsApp is learning to pick up the phone: two AI voice employees built on CosmiVoice, Cosmiron's own voice product, speaking Telugu, Hindi, English and the mix people really use on a call.
voice.logoAlt: CosmiVoice logo: a glowing profile wearing a headset

idents.name: AI Receptionist
idents.does: Answers every call that comes in.
idents.problem: No enquiry rings out. Not at lunch, not at nine at night.

idents.name: AI Calling
idents.does: Makes every call that should go out.
idents.problem: No follow-up waits for someone to find the time.

receptionist.sub: AI Receptionist. Every call in, answered.
receptionist.say: A loan enquiry that rings out is a lead that goes to someone else. The receptionist answers on the first ring, in the caller's language, at any hour, and hands the team a lead that already has an owner.
receptionist.ring: A call comes in to PaisaExpress. Nobody is at the desk.
caller: I want a home loan, around forty lakhs.
ai: I can help with that. Are you salaried, or do you run a business?

acts.title: Then it acts
items: Lead created, with what was said

calling.say: Follow-ups slip when the day fills up. The system already finds the files that have gone quiet. Next it makes the call itself, in the customer's language, and writes down what was said.
calling.note: The receptionist waits for the phone to ring. This one does not wait.
calling.dial: Each mark is a file gone quiet. The hand is the system, dialling.
ai: Hello, this is PaisaExpress. Your home loan is waiting on the property papers. Can you send them this week?
caller: Yes. I will upload them by Friday.

signoff.line: Home, personal and business loans, loans against property and credit cards. Hyderabad.
signoff.by: Agentic CRM designed and engineered by Cosmiron AI
